referenceSources.title: MAZDA 323 GT-R (1992-1994) - GUIDE OCCASION
referenceSources.description:
A white three-door Mazda 323 GT-R is positioned on a quiet, leaf-strewn country road, showcasing its rear hatch, integrated spoiler, and distinctive continuous red taillight bar. The ten-spoke alloy wheels and subtle body decals hint at its rally-bred all-wheel-drive system and turbocharged engine. Bare trees and fallen leaves frame the scene, indicating a late autumn setting.

This model, produced between 1992 and 1994, was homologated for Group A rallying with just 2,200 units built worldwide. Under the hood sits a 1.8‑liter turbocharged four-cylinder engine driving all four wheels via a viscous-coupled permanent AWD system. Known for its 185 horsepower (210 PS in Japan) and balanced 57/43 rear-biased torque split, the 323 GT-R delivers spirited performance and handling. Today, it remains a sought-after youngtimer, valued for its motorsport pedigree, mechanical simplicity, and relative affordability compared to other homologation specials.
